 "rationale": "A StrongARM latch draws no static current, so energy is just switched C times VDD^2. 160 fJ at 1.8 V allows about 49 fF total. All devices stay at L=0.15 and small, giving about 4x6 fF of internal nodes plus one CL transition. A 0.9 V input common mode leaves about 0.3 V of overdrive. The input-pair gain and a fast NMOS/PMOS regeneration time constant (about 15 ps) make 2 mV resolve in about 150 ps. During reset, internal nodes precharge high, so both outputs return low."}

PARAMS = {
    "w_tail": (3.0, 1.0, 8.0),    # clocked tail nfet width [um]
    "w_in":   (3.0, 1.0, 8.0),    # input pair width [um]
    "w_ln":   (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),    # latch nmos width [um]
    "w_lp":   (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),    # latch pmos width [um]
    "w_rst":  (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),   # reset pmos width [um]
    "w_on":   (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),   # output inverter nmos [um]
    "w_op":   (2.0, 0.84, 6.0),   # output inverter pmos [um]
    "l_in":   (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),  # input pair length [um]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = 0.15
    vdd = 1.8
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")

    # Clocked tail
    n.M("M0", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_tail"], L)
    # Input pair: vinp pulls dip, vinn pulls din
    n.M("M1", "dip", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["w_in"], p["l_in"])
    n.M("M2", "din", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["w_in"], p["l_in"])
    # Cross-coupled latch (xn over dip, xp over din)
    n.M("M3", "xn", "xp", "dip", "vss", "nfet", p["w_ln"], L)
    n.M("M4", "xp", "xn", "din", "vss", "nfet", p["w_ln"], L)
    n.M("M5", "xn", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_lp"], L)
    n.M("M6", "xp", "xn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_lp"], L)
    # Reset switches (clk low -> precharge all internal nodes to VDD)
    n.M("M7", "xn", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], L)
    n.M("M8", "xp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], L)
    n.M("M9", "dip", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], L)
    n.M("M10", "din", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], L)
    # Output inverters: outp = !xn (xn falls when vinp>vinn); reset -> both outputs low
    n.M("M11", "outp", "xn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_on"], L)
    n.M("M12", "outp", "xn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_op"], L)
    n.M("M13", "outn", "xp", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_on"], L)
    n.M("M14", "outn", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_op"], L)

    # ---------- first-order predictions ----------
    # Input pair operating point at start of evaluation (Vgs = vcm, tail vds small)
    opi = lut.op("n", p["w_in"], p["l_in"], vcm - 0.05, 0.9, 0.05)
    gm_in = opi["gm"]
    id_in = max(opi["Id"], 1e-6)

    cgate_per_um = 1.0e-15                       # approx gate cap per um (L=0.15)
    cj_per_um = 0.8e-15                          # approx drain junction/overlap per um
    c_di = cj_per_um * (p["w_in"] + p["w_ln"] + p["w_rst"])
    c_x = (cj_per_um * (p["w_ln"] + p["w_lp"] + p["w_rst"])
           + cgate_per_um * (p["w_ln"] + p["w_lp"] + p["w_on"] + p["w_op"]))

    # Phase 1: integration -- the di nodes discharge until the latch nmos turns on (~Vthn)
    vth_n = 0.62
    t1 = c_di * vth_n / id_in + c_x * 0.6 / id_in
    av = max(gm_in * vth_n / id_in, 1.0)        # integration gain ~ gm*Vth/Id
    # Phase 2: regeneration
    opl = lut.op("n", p["w_ln"], L, 0.9, 0.9)
    opp = lut.op("p", p["w_lp"], L, 0.9, 0.9)
    gm_l = opl["gm"] + opp["gm"]
    tau = c_x / max(gm_l, 1e-6)
    t2 = tau * math.log(max(vdd / (av * dv), 2.0))
    # Output inverter delay into CL
    opo = lut.op("p", p["w_op"], L, vdd, vdd / 2)
    t3 = 0.69 * cl * (vdd / 2) / max(opo["Id"], 1e-6) * 2
    delay = t1 + t2 + t3

    # Energy: all internal nodes recharged each cycle + one output CL charged
    c_int = 2 * c_di + 2 * c_x + cgate_per_um * (4 * p["w_rst"] + p["w_tail"])
    c_out = cl + cj_per_um * (p["w_on"] + p["w_op"])
    energy = (c_int + c_out) * vdd ** 2 * 1.15   # +15% short-circuit / kickback

    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
